en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestone paving. A large Baroque‑style church with a tall onion‑domed tower dominates the background. Around the square stand three‑ and four‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs and shopfronts at street level. Painted signs in German are visible on the facades. Horse‑drawn carts and several pedestrians in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing move across the square. The overall composition and border suggest an old photographic postcard.
